# LCWLD-030 fixtures — status

Required by the plan (`PLAN_LocalCWLDForce_OpenMM_Plugin.md` section 24,
LCWLD-030). All seven are now built and verified.

| Fixture | Status | Ground truth |
|---|---|---|
| `two_particle_directional.json` | Done | Hand-derived (plan section 46), independently re-verified by scalar arithmetic |
| `three_particle_chain.json` | Done | `localcwld_reference.compute_local_cwld`, cross-checked by independent central finite difference (h=1e-4/1e-5/1e-6) |
| `same_residue.json` | Done | Same, plus explicit invariant checks (density zero, chain force zero, pair energy nonzero) |
| `excluded_pair.json` | Done | Same, plus explicit invariant checks (everything exactly zero) |
| `pbc_cross_boundary.json` | Done | Same, plus lattice-translation invariance check; orthorhombic only (triclinic still TODO, see plan section 47) |
| `zmm_orders.json` | Done | `localcwld_reference.zmm_uclosure`/`zmm_duclosure_dr` for ell=1/2/3, cross-checked by finite difference and U/dU/dr→0 as r→rc |
| `water_ca_cluster.json` | Done | The REAL v2.6 `CustomGBForce` (1024-point tabulated kernel), evaluated via a single static `Context.getState()` call (no `Integrator.step()`); analytic reference recorded alongside for DEC-002 |

Regenerate/re-verify with (needs an interpreter with numpy; `water_ca_cluster`
additionally needs a real OpenMM install):

```bash
python docs/reports/generate_lcwld_030_fixtures.py       # 5 reference-only fixtures + regression check
python docs/reports/generate_water_ca_cluster_fixture.py # needs OpenMM
python -m pytest python/tests/test_reference_fixtures.py -v
```

See `docs/decisions/DEC-002-density-kernel.md` for the analytic-vs-tabulated
density kernel comparison this enabled, and
`docs/decisions/DEC-030-two-particle-fixture.md` for the hand-derived
fixture's provenance.

## Manifest / hashing convention

Each fixture JSON records inside itself:

- `fixture_schema_version`
- `formula_version` (currently `v2.6-compatible-1`)
- `generator` (what produced the numbers, and how to reproduce)

`sha256sums.txt` in this directory is regenerated by the generator scripts
after every successful run. Golden values must never be hand-edited after
generation; if a value needs to change, regenerate the whole fixture (and
say so in the PR description per plan section 42).
